  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R08 holds because the shipping address links 3 accounts. The household exception does not apply: although shipping is to home, the address was registered only 0.00931712962962963 days before ordering. No other rule holds, leaving Linkage as the sole adverse family under §6.6(b); no earlier outcome settles the order. The required id_check passed, so §5.3(a) mandates clear and prohibits further adverse action. Shared household use by a new customer is more plausible than synthetic identity after successful verification. No installments were due, so there is no repayment-based adverse inference. The order has already shipped. Recommend clear; no further check is needed."
